verdict.rationale: Fly.io's evidence shows GPUs you can run on Fly Machines (docs-52) and Machines you place and scale yourself (docs-43, docs-24). That is self-managed GPU infrastructure, a developer building block, not a managed global inference endpoint callable in one step without managing GPUs or capacity. The pack contains no documented serverless or managed model-inference API.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning

citations.quote: we can run a GPU on Fly.io while editing the app on our machine
you have control over every Machine’s lifecycle, resources, and region placement
